title: Cannot open the ledger database
hint: Reading the ledger failed at startup; the file may be corrupted. The app will not modify or delete your data file.
resetChannelHint: Reset the unreadable ledger to a brand-new empty one and enter the app right away.
resetConsequence: After resetting, the current ledger data will no longer be accessible in this app.
resetBody: A brand-new empty ledger will be created and opened immediately. The unreadable database file is kept as a copy (ledger.db.bak in the ledger data directory) for inspection or external repair; an existing copy with the same name will be overwritten.
resetOk: Reset to a brand-new empty ledger
